health.selection: PR-AUC on stratified training-only validation split
health.limitations: AI4I synthetic machine benchmark; no failure lead time/RUL and no verified mapping to MOIL machinery.

production.selection: Lowest MAE on the 2025-06-01 to 2025-08-06 time validation window
production.limitations: Time-ordered evaluation, source mine IDs absent; historical weather is not a forecast; transfer across mines is unvalidated.

grade.status: Experimental analogue grade only; source ranges unverified; no field-calibrated confidence interval

resource.status: Blocked: unit and provenance verification required
resource.reason: Source tons and unitless numbers cannot be treated as measured metric reserves. Borehole rows mostly generic surface/region descriptions. No defensible site-volume or recoverable reserve labels supplied.
